provenance.review_method: Rendered PDF pages were visually inspected; layout text was used only for navigation and token cross-checking. This ledger is transcribed from the human review report, not inferred from PDF extraction.
provenance.transcription_rule:
Every C01-C90 report row appears exactly once across entries and excluded_fragments. Markdown
markers are normalized to newline characters; tokens, comments, punctuation, names, and placeholder comments are retained.
provenance.continuation_handling: C18, C34, C60, and C90 retain their complete reviewed continuation. C90 includes printed page 101 solely to close the in-scope example.
